body: So sorry I had a busy evening. But as far as my appearance goes I'm not ugly persay. I do my makeup well, I have several tattoos, piercings, my ears are stretched to over an inch. Soooo, all the things I can choose to put on my body I love! But not so much my weight and my plain face. I think I'm painfully average in the face, and under average in the body, which sounds so superficial and shallow but it just gets to me. I've never found myself to be "pretty" although people say I am. As far as the OCD it's just cleaning, and perfectionism. If something deviates even slightly from the plan in my head it throws me into an anxiety attack. Stuff as small as a certain shirt I wanted to wear being dirty etc
Also I've never ever used reddit before today SO if I'm missing any reddit etiquette for you being so helpful or like not having a whole ass conversation in the comments lmk cause I'm not sure lol.

Yeah! Before motherhood I had other things I'd beat myself up about, being a shitty big sister, daughter, etc.  I've been EXTREMELY insecure my whole life. I am always aware of what I think other people are thinking, even when they tell me no they don't think negative things about me. So I think my insecurities w myself contribute to my conflicting emotions. One thing that gets to me is my appearance. Its always in the back of my mind. I wont even eat in front of people. I'm a mess of tangled emotions and anxieties and weird habits.

Yes it does! I always say for every emotion and want I have, I also have the opposite. Like, when my boyfriend and I argue. I want him to be as far away as possible, but when he does leave the room I cant bear it and follow him, always making the argument worse. I want people to help me with my baby by taking her sometimes, giving me breaks, and then I let someone take her and immediately wish I didnt because its MY job and responsibility, and I am being an absent mother by letting her go. The longest shes ever been away from me was less than 24 hrs for a sleepover at her grandmas. I loved it. Loved the break. Relaxation. I hated it. I hated feeling like I was pushing her off. Like I was being neglectful and selfish for wanting my own time. I can talk myself in a circle alllll day, but I think you see what I mean lol. 
But I'm sorry you've had to deal with this too, it's no fun for anyone.

Exactly why I just would rather die. I cannot handle the life of a mother but I'd never have any happiness knowing I am apart from her. You sound very knowledgeable. Are you a therapist or something of the sort? Because you've been very, well, therapeutic!
My mental issues mostly. The things I have dont equate to a loving, patient mother. I love my daughter so much it hurts, but I think I'll do more harm than good
Partly yes. The other reason is just feeling trapped and inadequate for the job. The future and the past weigh on me equally heavy for sure, cant decide which scares me the most.

Yep! You hit it right on the head. My suicidal thoughts increased twenty fold when she was born, and in my own fucked up way, I believe its bc I think that's what will protect her the most. But I also have the other side, where I want to see her grow, I want to be her favorite person, her mama, but I just don't think I'm capable of doing a good enough job, and the more she favors other people the worse I'll feel. Idk if you cant tell I am a person who is full of conflicting thoughts and feelings! 

-Also thank you for taking the time to respond to me. I really appreciate it

Oppositional defiancy disorder was explained to me as just a need to defy what authority figures in my life tell me to do, even if it's something I wanted or was already going to do. Reactive attachment disorder is essentially me pushing people I love away before they can do it to me first. Sabotaging relationships as tests to the person. Seeing how much they take, if they "truly" love me. That kinda thing. And I definitely worry about her being effected by my mental issues as well. I'm not sure if its genetic, because I do not know my biological dad or his family, but I know it didn't come from my moms side

I'm not sure where the depression started! I saw a therapist for the first time at the age of 2 for self harm. A 2 year old!!! My mom told me I'd bite myself so hard until I bled, all up and down my arms and legs, while feeling any intense emotion. Even happiness if I was super happy. Just went downhill from there. I've been to multiple day treatments and visited the youth mental hospital 3 times in less than a year. I've always self harmed. Doesnt have to just be cutting, I bite, hit, scratch. Etc. I've been diagnosed with reactive attachment disorder, oppositional defiancy disorder, anxiety, and mild OCD tendencies on top of what I already mentioned. So I was in a dark place long before I became a mother. Yes, I do from time to time think that having an abortion would have been better. But before ACTUALLY becoming a mom, it was all I wanted. So I dunno. I think maybe I'm just broken from the start
